introduction.title: About Me
introduction.subtitle: Hey, I'm Ayoub
introduction.description: I'm a curious and adaptable Full Stack Developer with a strong eye for detail and a passion for building intuitive and useful products. I thrive on turning complex ideas into elegant, user-friendly experiences that solve real problems.

tomtomAmigo.title: TomTom AmiGO
tomtomAmigo.description: TomTom AmiGO is a free, ad-free mobile navigation app available on Android, iOS, Android Auto and CarPlay. I contributed to the development of core features, UI components, and test automation as part of the international mobile team.
tomtomAmigo.techStack: Tech: React Native, Redux Saga, Java, Swift, Jest

escooterFinder.title: E-Scooter Finder
escooterFinder.description: An Android app that displays nearby e-scooters from multiple rental companies on a single map. Built with a custom backend that consumes GBFS feeds and processes geospatial data.
escooterFinder.frontend: Frontend: Kotlin, Google Maps SDK, MVVM

curriculumSimulator.title: Curriculum Simulator
curriculumSimulator.description: A web and mobile app that helps students visualize which courses are accessible based on their academic path. Used internally by my school.
curriculumSimulator.techStack: Tech: Java, Spring Boot, React Native, H2

stibRide.title: Stib Ride
stibRide.description: A pathfinding app to find the shortest route between two metro stations in Brussels' transport network, using JavaFX and graph theory.

rainbowAttack.title: Rainbow Attack
rainbowAttack.description: A C++ command-line tool to generate rainbow tables and crack SHA-256 hashes. Developed during my cybersecurity course to explore password cracking techniques.

readingEsi.title: Reading ESI
readingEsi.description: An Odoo module developed for a student bookstore to manage book rentals and sales. My first hands-on experience with ERP customization.

abalone.title: Abalone
abalone.description: Implementation of the Abalone board game using C++ and Qt Designer. Focused on clean architecture and user interaction.

game2048.description: My own take on the 2048 game, developed in JavaFX with a clean and responsive UI. A fun exercise in object-oriented design.

about.title: More About Me
about.description:
I'm Ayoub Lahyaoui, a {{age}}-year-old Belgian Full Stack Developer with a passion for clean design, user experience, and building things that make sense. After completing my bachelor's degree in Computer Science in Brussels, I dove straight into the industry to gain hands-on experience. I had the opportunity to join TomTom in Amsterdam for my final-year internship, where I contributed to their large-scale navigation app AmiGO. It was my first taste of working in an international Agile team, building features across React Native, Java, and Swift.

I then spent nearly two years as a Technical Consultant at Capgemini, where I helped clients in the public utility sector modernize their systems. I worked on both frontend and backend applications, mostly in microservice-based architectures. It sharpened my ability to write scalable code, collaborate with business stakeholders, and deliver real-world impact.

But over time, I felt the urge to go deeper to strengthen my foundations, sharpen my software craftsmanship, and explore topics like software design, human-computer interaction, and product thinking. That's why I decided to return to university to pursue a Master's degree in Computer Science in France.

Today, I'm focused on building thoughtful, reliable and well-designed applications always with the end user in mind. I care about details, love collaborative work, and value clear communication, curiosity, and continuous learning. I believe great software comes from a balance of empathy, rigor, and creativity.
